The dependency walk from the symptom side (GetServiceDependencies(frontend)) lands on productcatalogservice, whose pod is Ready=True with Restart Count 0 and whose logs are clean (gRPC server at :3550, 'successfully parsed product catalog json'), and CheckServiceConnectivity(productcatalogservice,3550) succeeds with the Service declaring port/targetPort 3550 and a matching selector - so the address, scheduling, probe and resource layers are all healthy. The break is therefore in the response content: code/productcatalogservice/product_catalog.go's GetProduct returns 'fmt.Errorf("Query product error.")' instead of the matched product for every existing product ID, while ListProducts still works (recommendationservice keeps receiving valid product_ids). The namespace events surface shows only setup-history FailedCreate serviceaccount rows (those SAs now exist) and transient rolling-restart probe warnings, none pointing at the current productcatalogservice condition. Root cause: application code returns an incorrect value/wrong response; victim: app/productcatalogservice.
